title: Render play #{{runIndex}}
description: Create a video from this recorded play. Choose encoding, recordings and a save folder on the computer running ADOFAI.
dmNoteUnavailable: Configure the ImplDmNote offline renderer in TUFReplay-Renderer to enable this.
keepGameOpen: Keep ADOFAI open while the video is being created. Missing camera or microphone recordings are skipped.

status.failed: The video could not be created

completedDescription: The finished video is saved on your computer. Open its save location to view or share it.
outputDirectoryPlaceholder: Choose a folder or enter its local path
outputDirectoryHelp: The finished video is saved in this folder on the computer running ADOFAI.
crfHelp: Lower values preserve more detail and create larger files. Range: 0–{{max}}.
proResHelp: The profile determines ProRes chroma quality and data rate. 4444 profiles preserve an alpha channel.
simulationFpsHelp: Simulation steps per second. Keep this at or above the video frame rate.
audioGainHelp: Adjusts game audio before recorded microphone audio is mixed.
endDelayHelp: Keep rendering for 0–30 seconds after the run ends. For a failed run, the wait starts after its death animation finishes, even at 0 seconds.
bgaModeHelp: Captures the level background while hiding tiles, planets and hit sounds.
